name: v5 plus (1x, extras, near-miss)
about: The 30 v5 items + single (1x) versions at half the reps + our extra gestures + near-miss cues (NOT commands) in random rounds, then 3 x 60 s idle; extra modules fill the time (near-miss block first). About 6 min per round. Converts to the v5 CSV with app_to_v5_csv.py (extra labels kept as they are).

activities.text: SIT STILL: sit relaxed and still, look at the screen
TALK: talk naturally the whole time (read aloud, chat)
CHEW: chew gum (or pretend) the whole time
TALK: chat with the experimenter, nod along when you agree
LOOK AROUND the room slowly, as if searching
TOUCH YOUR FACE: scratch, rub your ear, adjust hair or glasses
YAWN, take a DEEP BREATH, stretch your neck
